item.title: 激光熔覆中用于电磁屏蔽设计与预测的 FeCo 基软磁合金机器学习方法
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Luting Wang, Suiyuan Chen, Xiancheng Zhu, Zhiqing Fang, Mei Wang, Yifan Li, Lei Shen
本文结合实验数据推导结果和软磁材料数据库，提出多种机器学习策略，用于在近乎无限的成分空间中加速 FeCo 基多功能合金的设计与优化。研究将机器学习与激光增材制造相结合，旨在制备成分多样、功能集成且性能可调的电磁干扰屏蔽材料。该方法可快速、自动地筛选具有优化电磁屏蔽效能以及增强磁学和电学性能的 FeCo 基合金，为软磁电磁屏蔽材料的开发提供数据驱动途径。

item.title: Multi-Level-Set-Based Physics-Driven Neural Network to Solve 3-D Inverse Scattering Problems
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Yutong Du, Zicheng Liu, Bo Qi, Yali Zong, Peixian Han
arXiv:2609.08594v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: This paper proposes a level-set-based physics-driven neural network solver (LSPDNN) for 3-D electromagnetic inverse scattering. To mitigate boundary blurring and reconstruction artifacts in voxel-wise contrast reconstruction, the proposed solver exploits the piecewise homogeneity of practical scatterers by representing unknown targets with multiple coordinate-dependent neural level-set components. Specifically, a soft-union multi-material model is proposed to separately describe the object support and material distribution. The global support is formed by the union of multiple level-set components, while the local contrast is determined by normalized component weights and learnable complex permittivity candidates. In addition, a model-cons…

item.title: 在非互易联想神经网络中存储无限动力学吸引子
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Miguel Aguilera, Daniele De Martino
研究建立了非互易联想网络的动力学平均场理论，用于存储从极限环到奇异吸引子的大量动力学吸引子。通过含淬火无序的路径积分计算，推导出模式重叠、自相关和响应函数的自洽动力学方程，并表明记忆提取容量受编码存储模式的耦合矩阵谱结构控制。当特征值相位相干排列时，延迟自相互作用与淬火噪声产生破坏性反馈；而当特征值相位均匀分布时，二者大部分相互抵消，系统可约化为有效单自旋过程，容量显著提升。微观模拟验证了极限环和混沌吸引子的理论，表明特征值去相干是增强动力学记忆存储能力的关键机制。

item.title: PASS: Perturbation augmented space group structure sampling for transferable Fe-O machine learning interatomic potential
item.description:
📚 Preprints
👤 Zixiong Wei, Fei Shuang, Poulumi Dey
Iron (Fe) oxidation is a fundamental phenomenon that is scientifically significant and technologically vital. Despite substantial experiment research effort, accurate atomistic modelling of Fe oxidation remains elusive. This requires a reliable interatomic potential, which necessitates an extensive and representative first-principles dataset for training. However, Fe-oxygen (O) system is known for its structural and magnetic complexity, rendering the generation of high-quality dataset challenging. In this work, we propose the Perturbation Augmented Space group structure Sampling (PASS) method to generate representative dataset consisting of small-cell structures with less than 10 atoms. Based on PASS, we present a systematic approach to developing a transferable machine learning interatom…

item.title: 通用机器学习势在无机晶体结构全局优化中的性能
item.description:
📚 Machine Learning: Science and Technology
👤 Edan T Marcial, Laxman Chaudhary, Olesya Gorbunova and Aleksey N Kolmogorov
作者在无约束进化搜索中系统评估了12种预训练通用机器学习势，考察其在常压下预测多种非磁性无机体系复杂晶体基态方面的能力。结果显示，不同模型性能差异很大，从接近第一性原理计算到基本无法预测不等，尤其体现在低能量盆地内竞争相之间细微能量差的解析能力上。针对hcp-Zn、MB及LiB等体系的测试表明，部分模型能够捕捉由精细电子结构特征引起的微小能量差异。

item.title: 高能分子体系晶体结构预测的通用机器学习力场基准评测
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Musiha Mahfuza Mukta, Osman Goni Ridwan, Romain Perriot, Qiang Zhu
本文系统评估通用机器学习原子间势在高能分子晶体几何弛豫和能量排序中的可靠性，并考察其是否会破坏分子内部的期望连接关系。研究将MACE、MACE-OFF和UMA与GAFF经典力场结合，在大规模高能分子晶体数据库上检验经典力场预弛豫作为机器学习力场初始结构的作用。结果显示，直接使用MACE-OFF和UMA具有较高弛豫成功率并较好保持参考几何，而GAFF预弛豫能够以较低计算成本系统减少失败案例；不同模型在稳健性和计算效率之间存在权衡。

item.title: MLIP Detective: Active Failure Mode Discovery Beyond Benchmark Scores for Machine-Learning Interatomic Potentials
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Ryuhei Okuno, Nontawat Charoenphakdee, Kaoru Hisama, Yuta Tsuboi
arXiv:2609.08399v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Universal machine-learning interatomic potentials (u-MLIPs) aim to generalize across diverse configurations. Benchmarks enable reproducible evaluation but may not expose failures outside their predefined scope. Here, we show that physics-informed search can complement benchmark-based evaluation by uncovering hidden failure modes. We introduce MLIP Detective, an agentic framework for active failure mode discovery. Starting from benchmark evidence, MLIP Detective generates falsifiable, physics-informed failure hypotheses, screens them with inexpensive simulations, and escalates only the most suspicious cases to human experts together with proposed verification protocols. Without issue-specific prompting, MLIP Detective identified and charact…

item.title: 从粉末X射线衍射中识别多相材料的可扩展机器学习框架
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Xinyang Tong, Ethan Jin, Jiahan Xu, Aditya Rao, Pengcen Jiang, Nathan J. Szymanski
研究提出GALAXI，用于从粉末X射线衍射图谱中识别多种晶相。该方法不再采用一个覆盖所有候选相的封闭集分类器，而是为每种晶相训练独立的一对多二元分类器，先缩小候选范围，再通过里特维尔精修确定最能解释完整衍射图谱的相组合。在整理后的实验图谱数据集上，GALAXI取得0.935的micro-F1值，优于传统搜索匹配方法和已有深度学习模型，并对常见实验伪影保持较强鲁棒性。

item.title: Out-of-Distribution Inverse Design of Elastic Networks with Differentiable Graph Neural Network Molecular Dynamics
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Sergey A. Shteingolts, Salman N. Salman, Ron Levie, Dan Mendels
arXiv:2609.06655v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Machine-learning-based inverse design can accelerate the discovery of materials with targeted properties, but conventional structure--property models often require large training datasets and generalize poorly beyond their training distribution. Here, we present a differentiable inverse design framework based on a graph neural network molecular dynamics simulator. By combining a short dynamical initialization with physics-based refinement during simulation, the framework enables optimization well beyond the conditions represented in the training data. Using disordered elastic networks, we show that a simulator trained only on non-auxetic systems with Poisson's ratios between 0.1 and 0.4 can design strongly auxetic networks with values as low…

item.title: AI and TCAD for Inverse Design and Defect Discovery: From Simple Machine Learning to LLM
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Hiu Yung Wong
arXiv:2609.07046v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: AI has revolutionized various engineering domains, but its impact on semiconductor device design and defect discovery is still limited, due to limited data and the curse of dimensionality. In this paper, we will discuss our work on using the Technology Computer-Aided-Design (TCAD) to generate precise data needed for machine learning (ML) to enable simulation-augmented ML. We demonstrate that with minimal domain expertise, it is possible to create a machine that performs as well as a device engineer on a specific task. We will show that auto-encoder-based machine learning models and noise engineering applied to TCAD data are effective at learning latent physics, and that the models can be seamlessly applied to experimental data. We will demon…

item.title: A physics-informed neural network surrogate for multi-band reflection-loss prediction of carbon-fiber-reinforced polymer / Ti-6Al-4V ELI radar absorbing materials for UAV airframe integration
item.description:
📚 Preprints
👤 Abdullah Mevlüt Mutluel
Radar absorbing materials (RAM) are critical for stealth performance of unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs), but their design typically requires expensive parametric sweeps over frequency, incidence angle, and material thickness. This work presents a physics-informed neural network (PINN) surrogate model for rapid prediction of reflection loss (RL) of a metal-backed carbon-fiber-reinforced polymer (CFRP) absorber over the 2–18 GHz band and 0–80° transverse-electric (TE) incidence range. The model uses random Fourier feature embedding to mitigate spectral bias, combined with physics-based monotonicity and angular boundary regularization. Trained on a transfer matrix method (TMM) reference dataset of 6,400 samples in 42 s on a single CPU, the surrogate achieves a root-mean-square error of 0.22…

item.title: 用于低雷诺数后缘变形翼型快速气动预测的物理信息机器学习框架
item.description:
📚 Preprints
👤 Siddalingappa P Kodigaddi
研究针对低雷诺数下的抛物线弯度后缘变形翼型，基于 456 组 ANSYS Fluent 计算样本，构建并比较随机森林、梯度提升、多层感知器和高斯过程回归等代理模型，同时预测升力、阻力、俯仰力矩、升阻比及表面压力指标。引入攻角三角分解和无量纲 δ²/Re 交互项等物理信息特征后，预测误差最高降低 18%；其中梯度提升模型对升力系数取得较高的决定系数，表明该物理信息机器学习框架可支持变形翼型的快速设计空间探索。

item.title: Beyond Residuals: Energy based solutions of partial differential equations using scientific machine learning
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Timon Rabczuk, Yizheng Wang
arXiv:2609.08239v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Energy-based approaches provide a natural and physically consistent framework for a large class of partial differential equations arising in solid and fluid mechanics, where the governing equations follow from variational principles. In contrast to residual-based physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) and their weak-form variants, which enforce the strong or weak form of the equations through loss minimization, the Deep Energy Method (DEM) directly computes the solution as the minimizer of an energy or incremental potential functional. This eliminates the need for residual weighting, avoids high-order derivatives, and enables the direct enforcement of physical constraints through the variational structure.In this work, we systematically re…

item.title: Physics-informed neural networks for viscoelastic fluid flows around a cylinder in a two-dimensional channel
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Midhuna Suresh, Akanksha Gupta
arXiv:2609.07861v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Grid-based fluid dynamics solvers routinely struggle with exhaustive meshing demands and ill-posed inverse problems. A practical mesh-free alternative is given by Physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) but, applying them to highly elastic Oldroyd-B fluids results in many training failures. The High Weissenberg Number Problem (HWNP), driven by the exponential stress growth near stagnation points is a major issue, which causes standard PINN optimizers to diverge. To prevent the network from crashing, we apply a Cholesky decomposition to the conformation tensor. This mathematical constraint stabilizes the gradients by guaranteeing a positive-definite stress field. Beyond mathematical stability, the inherent spectral bias of deep learning mode…

item.title: Solving the Elastic Wave Equation with Physics-Informed Neural Networks: A Robust and Critical Assessment
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Davide Staub, Ben Moseley
arXiv:2609.07983v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Physics-Informed Neural Networks (PINNs) have recently emerged as a promising approach for solving Partial Differential Equations (PDEs), offering a meshfree alternative that integrates physical principles into the learning process. This presents a new paradigm compared to traditional discretization methods and purely data-driven machine learning techniques. While promising, PINNs are not a panacea; they inherit challenges such as spectral bias and unstable convergence. Moreover, their potential in seismology remains largely unexplored. In this work, we provide a robust and critical assessment of PINNs for solving the elastic wave equation in seismology. We investigate the performance of PINNs on problems with varying degrees of complexity a…

item.title: 具有Z₃ parafermion非阿贝尔统计的多组分超导体1/3磁通束缚态
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Xing-Yu Wu, Y. H. Wang, X. C. Xie, Yijia Wu
研究提出，具有C₃旋转对称性的多组分超导体中，1/3超导磁通量子束缚的电子态可能实现Z₃ parafermion的非阿贝尔统计。受禁止双重占据约束时，对1/3磁通束缚态进行两次连续编织，等价于一次Z₃ parafermion编织操作。编织结果对应的parafermion宇称可通过1/3磁通束缚态的费米子占据数读出；结合交叉Andreev反射诱导的Hadamard门，有望实现完整的Z₃ parafermion编织操作集合。

item.title: 具有自旋电子学读出的磁机械陀螺仪
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Andrea Meo, Francesca Garesci, Pedro Bossi Nunez, Maddalena Fiorentino, Teresa Natale, Ludovico Dindelli, Victor Lopez-Dominguez, Banibrato Sinha, Riccardo Tomasello, Francesco Dell'Olio, Pedram Khalili Amiri, Mario Carpentieri, Giovanni Finocchio
作者提出一种类似MEMS的双自由度磁机械陀螺仪，利用磁性隧道结的整流功能同时实现读出和机械动力学换能。研究基于实验表征的磁性隧道结参数，对结合微磁理论与双自由度机械方程的磁机械模型进行校准和面向实验的设计。实验表明，输出信号与角速度呈线性关系，并可通过同频解调提取动态角速度，为摆脱严格电容间隙限制、实现紧凑且兼容CMOS的读出方案提供了路径。

item.title: 交替磁体中的电荷—自旋转换：电子各向异性与磁振子介导的自旋拖曳
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Koki Mizuno
本文在统一模型下比较金属铁磁体、反铁磁体和交替磁体中的自旋分辨电导，并分别处理磁振子自能导致的自旋对角通道与电子—磁振子耦合的一阶自旋翻转通道。结果表明，电荷—自旋转换的各向异性主要由电子动量依赖的自旋劈裂决定，磁振子分支的贡献仅处于次要地位。磁振子介导的自旋翻转通道在C₄变换下为偶性，因而在各向异性一阶近似下不能单独区分交替磁体与普通反铁磁体；降低体相B₁g对称性的亚晶格选择性扰动则可激发相应响应。

item.title: Contrasting roles of the superexchange and direct exchange interactions in the metal-insulator transitions of the 2D ferromagnetic 1T-FeX₂ (X=Cl, Br, I) monolayers
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Hongxu Luo, Baoyang Zhou, Sai Lyu
arXiv:2609.08807v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Within the rapidly growing family of two-dimensional (2D) materials, 2D ferromagnetic (FM) materials have attracted a great deal of recent attention. The ferromagnetism in 2D FM materials originates from the underlying exchange interactions. In particular, metal-insulator transitions (MITs) in 2D FM materials induced via various modulation strategies is critical to the design of 2D electronic devices with reduced sizes (e.g. transistor). However, the critical behaviors of exchange interactions and their effects on the Curie temperatures near MITs remains to be clarified. By taking the 2D FM 1T-FeX2 (X=Cl, Br, I) monolayers as the testbeds, we computationally study the critical behaviors of the exchange interactions in the vicinity of the MIT…

item.title: 通过径向与横向相互作用调控旋转磁性微粒的成对动力学
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Dongfang Fu, Leilei Wang, Kailai Wang, Xu Zheng, Zaiyi Shen
本文建立了同步旋转磁性微粒对的约化动力学框架，将粒子间相互作用分解为改变间距的径向分量和转动连心线的横向分量。磁偶极相互作用、额外径向排斥以及旋转诱导横向耦合之间的竞争，可选择刚体旋转、接触—分离旋转和不可逆分离三种成对运动模式。作者推导了刚体态、反向轨道运动和分离边界的转变判据，并获得分离动力学的渐近解；近壁格子玻尔兹曼模拟为该模型提供了流体动力学实现。

item.title: 超导体中非均匀非磁性杂质的作用：微观理论与宏观理论的比较
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Carlos Redondo Herrero, Tejas Guruswamy, Orlando Quaranta, Akira Miyazaki
本研究利用Eilenberger方程分析超导体内部非均匀非磁性杂质对电磁响应的影响，并检验基于London方程的宏观描述。对于任意空间杂质分布，两种理论给出的电磁场分布相同，但与磁场相关的物理量并不一致：宏观模型只能得到Bean–Livingston势垒，而微观理论能够给出实验相关的超热场。基于微观形式，研究确定了一类可使超热场等于临界场的杂质分布，从而达到理论上的最大超热场。

item.title: 纯向列量子临界超导体中的扩展奇异金属区
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Kousuke Ishida, Kiyotaka Mukasa, Shusaku Imajo, Andrew Hardy, Mingwei Qiu, Mikihiko Saito, Aavishkar A. Patel, Kohei Matsuura, Yuichi Sugimura, Yu Uezono, Takumi Otsuka, Nigel E. Hussey, Takao Watanabe, Koichi Kindo, Takasada Shibauchi
本文在非磁性FeSe₁₋ₓTeₓ中利用强脉冲磁场揭示了超导穹顶下方被掩盖的奇异金属基态，该体系具有由纯电子向列序驱动的量子临界点。奇异金属区并非局限于量子临界点上方通常预期的扇形区域，而是跨越较宽的成分范围，且非磁性向列临界涨落可能增强配对相互作用。与较洁净的FeSe₁₋ₓSₓ中典型的向列量子临界扇区相比，Te掺杂引入的空间无序可能扩展了量子临界区域。

item.title: Nb-Mn-Ge Kagome 化合物中磁性、电子结构与成键特性的第一性原理研究
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Wei-Shen Tee, Shiya Chen, Weiyi Xia, Peter Minch, Cai-Zhuang Wang, Vladimir Antropov
作者利用第一性原理计算系统研究了预测稳定的 NbMn₆Ge₆、亚稳态菱方 NbMn₆Ge₅ 和 NbMn₆Ge₄ 的磁基态、电子结构及成键特征。NbMn₆Ge₆ 偏好共线反铁磁态，而 NbMn₆Ge₅ 和 NbMn₆Ge₄ 偏好铁磁态；Mn 原子磁矩近似局域化，表明可采用广义自旋哈密顿量描述。反铁磁 NbMn₆Ge₆ 和铁磁 NbMn₆Ge₅ 具有易轴磁各向异性，铁磁 NbMn₆Ge₄ 则表现为面内各向异性；电荷密度差与电子局域函数揭示了 Mn-Ge Kagome 网络及层间的电荷重排和成键特征。费米能级附近未发现适合研究拓扑磁性的电子结构特征，相关预测仍需通过实验合成、结构表征和磁性测量验证。

item.title: g-wave altermagnetic order parameter in hematite
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Tianren Wang, Yuehong Li, Yu Feng, Andong Liu, Yuetong Wu, Qian Zhao, Yujie Yan, Wei Luo, Xin Tong, Yi Lu, Yao Shen, Stefano Agrestini, Jaewon Choi, Qisi Wang
arXiv:2609.08693v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Altermagnets combine the vanishing net magnetization of antiferromagnets with momentum-dependent spin splitting. Magnon band splitting provides a direct probe of altermagnetic order and may enable chirality-selective magnon transport, yet the momentum-space symmetry of this splitting has not been determined quantitatively. Here we use inelastic neutron scattering to map the momentum dependence of altermagnetic magnon splitting in hematite (α-Fe₂O₃₎. The splitting vanishes along nodal directions and reaches maxima off the nodes, revealing the g-wave symmetry of the altermagnetic order parameter. These results agree with linear spin-wave theory calculations based on the altermagnetic model, which further identify the nondegenerate branches as…

item.title: 适用于一般多轨道Hofstadter模型的规范协变磁性Bloch和
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Hao Shi, Tianyu Qiao, Wangqian Miao, Jin-Tao Jin, Quansheng Wu, Xi Dai
作者针对一般二维多轨道Peierls紧束缚哈密顿量，提出基于规范协变磁性Bloch和基的统一Hofstadter问题处理方法。该构造保留完整布拉维几何、任意晶胞内轨道位置、原始跃迁表以及轨道嵌入和跃迁范围等信息；在有理磁通p/q下，可将问题化为维数由原胞磁通决定的最小磁性布洛赫块。文中还推导了斜朗道规范下的稀疏矩阵形式，并讨论能带计数、谱冗余、陈数、磁性空间约束和磁通周期性等性质。

item.title: 人机协同发现可重构的面内铁电超畴控制
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Yu Liu, Boris Slautin, Ching-Che Lin, Jaegyu Kim, Lane W. Martin, Sergei V. Kalinin
研究提出扫描探针智能研究循环（SPARC）框架，由编码智能体与人工操作者共享显微镜、实验记录本以及用于积累结论和分析或仪器失效模式的持久化记忆文件。该框架被应用于（111）取向PbZr₀.₂Ti₀.₈O₃薄膜面内超畴方向的重构：智能体通过重新分析既有测量，发现了由交替极性的定向固定偏压脉冲组成的操作方案。随后在智能体控制的实验中，将已知陷阱编译为检查项，以提高探索效率和实验可靠性。

item.title: 方格—八边形超导体中的干涉调控磁性束缚态与隙下输运
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Ravi Kiran

item.title: 纤锌矿晶体中光促进的铁电翻转
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Ricardo Jiménez-Sánchez, Fernando Salazar, Miguel Cruz-Irisson, Riccardo Rurali, Claudio Cazorla
研究利用第一性原理计算，提出通过带隙以上光激发、在无外加电场条件下降低纤锌矿铁电体的翻转势垒。以LaN为代表体系，光生载流子显著减小非极性六方中间相与极性纤锌矿基态之间的能量差，从而降低铁电翻转能垒。其机制在于极性相发生光诱导部分金属化，屏蔽稳定铁电序的偶极–偶极相互作用，使竞争性的非极性结构更有利。对岩盐多晶型的分析进一步支持了该机制的普适性。

item.title: Kondo 晶格材料 Ce₅RhGe₂ 与 Ce₅IrGe₂ 的磁性相
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Jiawen Zhang, Yanan Zhang, Mingyi Wang, Ye Chen, Yu Liu, Yongjun Zhang, Michael Smidman, Huiqiu Yuan
本文通过电阻率、比热和磁化测量系统研究单晶 Ce₅RhGe₂ 与 Ce₅IrGe₂ 的磁性，并将结果与 Ce₅CoGe₂ 比较。三种化合物均具有正交晶系 Pnma 结构，晶格参数从 Co 到 Rh 再到 Ir 单调增大，表现出负化学压力效应；易磁化方向在整个系列中均为晶体学 a 轴。Ce₅RhGe₂ 在约 11.5 K 发生铁磁有序，而 Ce₅IrGe₂ 在 12.7 K 和 11.8 K 出现两次连续磁转变，并在磁场下表现出多重变磁转变及约为饱和磁化强度五分之一和三分之一的磁化平台。

item.title: 非中心对称超导体中热激活相位滑移的磁手性各向异性
item.description:
📚 arXiv

item.title: 多带超导体相干长度与磁场穿透深度的微观计算
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Tristan Ryoma Fuchs, Takuya Nomoto, Hikaru Watanabe, Ryotaro Arita

Landslide susceptibility mapping depends critically on the definition of the non-landslide class. In many study areas, including the Rif of northern Morocco, the completeness of landslide inventories cannot be guaranteed, making conventional random absence sampling unreliable. This study proposes MC-PU-2S (Monte Carlo Positive-Unlabeled Two-Step), a probabilistic extension of classical PU Two-Step learning, and compares it with Enhanced Information Value (EIV) and deterministic PU Two-Step on a database of 5,877 observations (2,320 mapped landslides, 3,557 unlabeled) described by 21 conditioning factors.
